## checklist

- [ ] commits follow `type(scope): what changed`
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass, if rust changed
- [ ] new behavior has a test, or the pr says why it can't
- [ ] no new lint suppressions
